title: Schema, two fixture backlogs and failing tests
goal: The expected rows of two invented backlogs, committed failing against an empty tool
acceptance: `core/tools/backlog-index.mjs` exists with the CLI (`build --db --repo --source|--remote`, `dump --db`) and the schema (`sources`, `records`, `steps`, `depends_on`, `prs`, `problems`, `PRAGMA user_version`) and no reader yet

Two invented fixture backlogs, built as throwaway git repositories like the other tool tests: source-owned records with step files (an open feature with an owner step, a `repo:ID` dependency, a closed step with a PR) and an authored four-column backlog (a P1 bug, a record needing human action), plus one unknown layout

Failing tests committed first: the expected `dump` of each fixture, a second build giving the same `dump`, the unknown layout giving a `problems` row and no records; the later steps never edit them to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented; a token is read from the environment, never written.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the coordinator proposal's 4 h (live index decision page, row S1), failing test first. Not a measurement.
